(Source: Bloomberg)

Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida, and now a global economic adviser for Pimco, says said the central bank risks creating uncertainty if it alters its preferred inflation measure without clearly communicating what policymakers are targeting. Clarida offered that caution on Friday on "Bloomberg Money" in the wake of Chairman Kevin Warsh’s suggestion for a review of possible alternatives to the US personal consumption expenditure core index, known by the acronym PCE. Clarida speaks to Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is considering reducing the frequency of the central bank’s scheduled policy meetings, the New York Times reported Friday.
Warsh raised the proposal to change the frequency of meetings at this week’s gathering of the Federal Open Market Committee, the paper added.
Bloomberg Managing Editor Kate Davidson said changing the schedule would be the biggest change for Warsh. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Galante Warns Iran Could Target US Infrastructure
title_cn: 加兰特警告伊朗可能针对美国基础设施
summary: Laura Galante, a former director of the Cyber Threat Intelligence Integration Center, warns that Iran could retaliate against new US strikes with cyberattacks on American infrastructure, citing "good precedent" and encouraging operators to strengthen basic defenses as the risk grows. Her comments come after reports that US and state officials believe Iranian hackers were likely behind attacks on more than 30 municipal water systems in Minnesota. At a Cabinet meeting Friday, President Trump rejected that explanation and blamed Minnesota's government for the attacks, without providing evidence. Galante speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Miller Warns of 'Drastic Expansion' of Iran War
title_cn: 米勒警告伊朗战争“急剧扩大”
summary: Aaron David Miller, a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, warns that a new US attack on Iran could trigger a "major and drastic" expansion of the conflict. His comments come amid reports that President Donald Trump has ordered a fresh round of strikes that could begin as soon as this weekend, as the US and Israel reportedly consider targeting Iranian energy infrastructure. Miller says a limited bombing campaign is unlikely to change Tehran's calculations, while renewed escalation would make progress toward a Gaza ceasefire even less likely. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness Hit by AI Selloff
title_cn: 利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 的态势感知受到人工智能抛售的打击
summary: Bloomberg's Hema Parmar details the massive selloff of AI assets from Situational Awareness, one of the world's biggest hedge funds and how Citadel's Ken Griffin stepped in to buy the investments. Parmar said that this move is part of Griffin's 'playbook' and he will often jump in to get a good deal when firms are in distress. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: New Poll Shows El-Sayed With Edge Over Stevens in Michigan Dem Primary
title_cn: 新民意调查显示，埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州民主党初选中领先史蒂文斯
summary: Spencer Kimball, director of the Emerson College Polling Center, said that Abdul El-Sayed has managed to keep an edge on Haley Stevens in Emerson's poll of the Michigan democratic primary for Senate because he has managed to put together a coalition of younger people and educated voters around the state. Kimball said that because Democrats are the party out of power, he suspects voters will rally around whichever candidate wins Tuesday's primary.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Push for 100 Years of B-52 Sees Delay, Costs Up, GAO Says
title_cn: 美国政府问责局表示，美国推动 B-52 研发 100 年的计划遭到推迟，成本上升
summary: A $21 billion Air Force effort managed by Boeing Co. to upgrade the engines, radar and communications of the iconic B-52 bomber is seeing cost growth and delays during early development, according to a congressionally mandated audit.

title: Brazil Party Blocks Senator From Becoming Bolsonaro Running Mate
title_cn: 巴西党阻止参议员成为博尔索纳罗竞选搭档
summary: An influential Brazilian political party blocked one of its key members from becoming Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate in October’s presidential election, dealing another blow to his chaotic campaign.

title: Trump Says He's Losing Confidence in Iranian Negotiators
title_cn: 特朗普称他对伊朗谈判代表失去信心
summary: "I’m losing faith in them because they do lie and do, they do misrepresent," President Donald Trump says during the meeting at the Camp David presidential retreat in Maryland. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Yet to Approve Any Midterm Spending From $401 Million PAC
title_cn: 特朗普尚未批准 4.01 亿美元 PAC 的任何中期支出
summary: Donald Trump has not signed off on a plan to spend any of the $401 million he’s amassed from political donors in November’s midterm elections, according to a Republican strategist familiar with the discussions, despite public assertions from his team that the president’s super PAC will provide a major boost to GOP candidates.

title: Centrists and Democratic-Socialist-Backed Progressives Face Off in Michigan
title_cn: 中间派和民主社会主义支持的进步派在密歇根州对峙
summary: Proponents say the debate could redefine the party, while Republicans draw comparisons to their history and work to capitalize on it.

title: Chicago School Board Budget Hangs on Uncertain State Funding
title_cn: 芝加哥学校董事会预算因国家资金不确定而悬而未决
summary: The Chicago Board of Education approved a roughly $10 billion budget that relies on uncertain state funding and rolls back proposed teacher layoffs.

title: Attacks Between Iran Will Continue Says Trump (Q&A)
title_cn: 特朗普称伊朗之间的袭击将继续（问答）
summary: President Donald Trump said he’s losing confidence in Iranian negotiators, the latest sign that the renewal of armed hostilities in the Middle East could drag on.  Speaking during a Cabinet meeting on Friday, Trump took issue with missile attacks that Iran launched earlier this week against US forces in Jordan that ended a multi-day pause in fighting.  (Source: Bloomberg)
